item.name: Cancel Order
item.description: Cancel an order. When cancelled, stock is automatically restored for all products. The order can be restored within 3 minutes using the PATCH endpoint.

item.name: Update Order Items
item.description: Update the items in an order. Only allowed when order status is PENDING. All items must belong to the same merchant. Stock is reconciled automatically. Use quantity: 0 to remove an item from the order. At least one item must remain with quantity > 0.

item.name: Remove Item from Order
item.description: Remove an item from the order by sending quantity: 0. At least one item must remain in the order with quantity > 0.
